headline: The backend defects and security holes from the F34 audit are fixed: events wait for the commit, Writing-phase card text is hidden, rule violations return 409, closed sprints are read-only, kicks are soft, names are unique, and outbound fetches and sign-in redirects are checked.

presumed.what: Kept the plan's four source-required departures from skills (domain-patterns, error-handling, authorization-patterns, create-domain-event-handler).
presumed.why: Each is required by the spec (BE-07/12/20) or its Out of scope; the architect recommended keep.

pluginFindings.finding: The Codex code-review job failed inside its early window with no output.
No installed plugin runs vstest, so named-file and tied test runs fell back to the whole unit role and integration runs needed a new declared role.
verify-run records cut the exception message out of failed runs, hiding the cause of intermittent failures.
An approval-scope stamp with directory paths matches nothing and logs false-positive violations.
